qa_pairs.question: Which charger does the NovaBook 14 need, and what happens if a lower-wattage adapter is used?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The NovaBook 14 charges through either USB-C port with a 65 W USB-C Power Delivery adapter. A lower-wattage adapter may charge slowly but may not maintain charge during heavy use.

qa_pairs.expected_answer: The NovaBook 14 has a 24-month limited hardware warranty, while the AeroBuds Pro have a 12-month warranty. Coverage begins on confirmed delivery for shipped orders and on collection for store-pickup orders.

qa_pairs.question: How many business days do standard and express domestic shipping normally take after dispatch?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Standard domestic shipping normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch, and express shipping in one to two business days after dispatch. These are service estimates, not guarantees, and orders to designated remote areas require two additional business days.

contexts.text: Standard domestic shipping normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch. Express shipping normally arrives in one to two business days after dispatch. qa_pairs.question: My order already moved to Packing. Can I still cancel it, and if not, how do I get my money back?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Once the status becomes Packing, cancellation is no longer guaranteed. Support may request a carrier interception, but interception fees are non-refundable and success is not guaranteed. If interception fails, the customer must use the return process after delivery. After inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days.

contexts.text: Once the status becomes `Packing`, cancellation is no longer guaranteed. Support may request a carrier interception, but interception fees are non-refundable and success is not guaranteed. If interception fails, the customer must use the return process after delivery.
After inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days.

qa_pairs.question: Can I pay with two gift cards plus one credit card and also apply two different percentage-off codes to the same order?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The payment part is allowed: up to two gift cards may be combined with one card payment. The promotional part is not. Only one percentage-off promotional code may be applied to an order, and a percentage code may be combined with a gift card, but not with another percentage code or a clearance markdown.

contexts.text: Customers may pay by supported credit or debit card, OrbitTech gift card, or bank transfer. Up to two gift cards may be combined with one card payment.
Only one percentage-off promotional code may be applied to an order. A percentage code may be combined with a gift card, but not with another percentage code or a clearance markdown.

qa_pairs.question: The box arrived crushed and one item is missing. What is my reporting deadline and what evidence do I need, and does the same process apply to a fault I only notice weeks later?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Visible shipping damage or missing items must be reported within 48 hours after confirmed delivery, and the customer should keep the packaging and provide photographs of the label, box, and contents. A concealed defect discovered later follows the warranty or return policy rather than the shipping-damage process. A return caused by a verified defect or OrbitTech shipping error includes a prepaid return label.

contexts.text: Visible shipping damage or missing items must be reported within 48 hours after confirmed delivery. The customer should keep the packaging and provide photographs of the label, box, and contents. A concealed defect discovered later follows the warranty or return policy rather than the shipping-damage process.

qa_pairs.question: I think someone broke into my account and placed an order that still shows Confirmed. What should I do?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The customer should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. Because the unauthorized order is still Confirmed, they should also attempt cancellation, which can be done from the account page while the status is Confirmed.

contexts.text: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security.
An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is `Confirmed`.

contexts.text: Opened ear-tip packages are treated as hygiene accessories under `05_returns_and_exchanges.md`.
Opened ear tips, in-ear audio products, screen protectors, and other hygiene or single-use accessories are non-returnable unless defective.

qa_pairs.question: Can an OrbitPlus member borrow a replacement laptop while their own is being repaired, and what conditions apply?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Yes. Active OrbitPlus members may request a loaner for a covered laptop or phone repair, subject to availability, identity verification, and a refundable USD 200 deposit. The membership document confirms the loaner is available only during some covered repairs and requires a refundable deposit.

contexts.text: Active OrbitPlus members may request a loaner for a covered laptop or phone repair, subject to availability, identity verification, and a refundable USD 200 deposit.

qa_pairs.question: My repair has been waiting on an unavailable part for over 15 business days and the team missed its published response period. What options do I have?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy. A formal service complaint may also be filed after the assigned team misses a published response period. The complaint should identify the case number, requested resolution, and relevant evidence, and a supervisor reviews it within five business days.

contexts.text: If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

A formal service complaint may be filed after the assigned team misses a published response period or closes a case without addressing the stated issue. The complaint should identify the case number, requested resolution, and relevant evidence. A supervisor reviews it within five business days.

qa_pairs.question: I placed an order on August 20, 2026 and it was delivered on September 10, 2026. I have opened the device and want to return it. How many days do I have and what restocking fee applies?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Return Policy version 1.0 applies, because for return-policy eligibility the triggering event is the order-placement date and the order was placed before September 1, 2026. Version 1.0 allows seven calendar days for an opened device and charges a 15% opened-device restocking fee. The number of return days is counted from confirmed delivery, so the seven days run from September 10, 2026.

contexts.text: For return-policy eligibility, the triggering event is the order-placement date, while the number of return days is counted from confirmed delivery.

Return Policy version 1.0 applies to orders placed before September 1, 2026. It allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices, seven calendar days for opened devices, and charged a 15% opened-device restocking fee.

qa_pairs.question: My OrbitPlus membership was active when I ordered on August 28, 2026. Does the 45-day unopened-device return window apply to that order?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. The 45-day OrbitPlus unopened-device benefit was introduced with version 2.0, and orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership. For version 2.0 orders the extension applies only when OrbitPlus was active on the order date, and it never extends the 14-day opened-device window, hygiene exclusions, or a product warranty.

contexts.text: The 45-day OrbitPlus unopened-device benefit was introduced with version 2.0. Orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership. For version 2.0 orders, the extension applies only when OrbitPlus was active on the order date.

OrbitPlus extends the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days for eligible purchases made while membership is active. It does not extend the 14-day opened-device window, override hygiene exclusions, or extend a product warranty.

qa_pairs.question: I dropped my PulsePhone X and cracked it, then bought OrbitPlus the next day. Is the drop damage now a warranty claim?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. The warranty excludes accidental impact, and accidental damage is not converted into a warranty claim by purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident. OrbitPlus does not extend a product warranty. The damage may still be repairable for a fee.

contexts.text: The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider.

It does not extend the 14-day opened-device window, override hygiene exclusions, or extend a product warranty.

qa_pairs.question: My device was replaced under warranty and I cannot find the original order number. Does the replacement start a fresh 24-month warranty, and how is my coverage period established without proof of purchase?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A replacement device does not restart a new 24-month warranty, and replacement parts are covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty. A claim requires an order number or other acceptable proof of purchase; when proof is unavailable, OrbitTech may use the recorded serial-number shipment date, which can shorten the apparent coverage period.

contexts.text: Replacement parts are covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty. A replacement device does not restart a new 24-month warranty.

A claim requires an order number or other acceptable proof of purchase. When proof is unavailable, OrbitTech may use the recorded serial-number shipment date, which can shorten the apparent coverage period.

qa_pairs.question: My express bundle order was held at customs and arrived after the committed date. I want the express fee back and I want to return the bundle but keep the free gift. What do I actually get?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The express-shipping fee is not refunded. Express fees are refunded when an express package arrives after the carrier's committed service date, unless the delay resulted from a listed carrier exception, and a customs hold is one of those exceptions. A promotional bundle must also be returned as a bundle: if the customer keeps the free gift, its stated promotional value is deducted from the refund.

contexts.text: Express-shipping fees are refunded when an express package arrives after the carrier's committed service date, unless the delay resulted from an incorrect address, unavailable recipient, customs hold, severe weather, or another listed carrier exception.
A promotional bundle must be returned as a bundle. If a customer keeps a free gift or one bundled item, its stated promotional value is deducted from the refund.
A free gift that is not returned causes its stated promotional value to be deducted.

qa_pairs.expected_answer: This request is outside the scope of the OrbitTech Customer Support Assistant, because medical diagnosis is an explicit out-of-scope example. The assistant should briefly explain its role and offer examples of supported OrbitTech topics rather than giving medical advice.
